library: AI Guru Problem-Solving Reference Video Library

selectionPolicy.description: A reference video may be selected only when the lesson has a meaningful concept/term match with the reference. Subject/domain and grade compatibility are supporting signals, not sufficient by themselves.
selectionPolicy.forbidden: Do not select a reference merely because the subject, grade or domain matches.

notes: The physical reference-video library contains approved teaching-style references with concept metadata, teaching prompts and QA instructions.
The latest uploaded linear-equation reference replaces any earlier linear-equation referral asset. Only the latest uploaded file is packaged.
A separate Mathlet-derived visual-template registry is maintained alongside the physical video assets. These templates are not counted as physical videos.
V51.4: all 20 physical reference assets are isolated under problem-solving branches; normal classroom RAG never sends these videos to Gemini repeatedly.
V51.6: these 20 physical assets are reserved exclusively for Material Studio → Problems and Formulae. Classroom strategy selection excludes this registry.
